Mr. Speaker, I heard what I heard, and I heard both the Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Finance and the hon. member for Gloucester say that Petro-Canada gives the government control over an important sector of the industry. It is impossible to run a seismic line, it is impossible to drill a well, it is impossible to put in some pumps, it is impossible to put in a pipeline, it is impossible to put in a refinery, it is impossible to do anything without getting government permission. There are several hundred employees of E M and R, under various pieces of legislation plus something called moral suasion, exercising tremendous control over the oil industry. There is the National Energy Board with its several hundred employees licensing virtually every activity of the oil and gas industry. It is one of the most regulated industries imaginable.
